{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    segments = case['segments']
    budget = case['budget']
    names = []
    importances = []
    mins = []
    caps = []
    for seg in segments:
        name = seg['name']
        imp = seg['importance']
        min_ = seg['minimum']
        cap = seg['capacity']
        if min_ > cap:
            raise ValueError(f"minimum {min_} exceeds capacity {cap} for segment {name}")
        names.append(name)
        importances.append(imp)
        mins.append(min_)
        caps.append(cap)
    total_min = sum(mins)
    total_cap = sum(caps)
    if budget < total_min or budget > total_cap:
        raise ValueError(f"Budget {budget} not feasible: sum mins={total_min}, sum caps={total_cap}")
    current = mins[:]
    remaining = budget - total_min
    n = len(segments)
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_num = -1
        best_den = 1
        for i in range(n):
            if current[i] >= caps[i]:
                continue
            num = importances[i]
            den = current[i] + 1
            if best_idx == -1:
                best_idx = i
                best_num = num
                best_den = den
            else:
                left = num * best_den
                right = best_num * den
                if left > right:
                    best_idx = i
                    best_num = num
                    best_den = den
                elif left == right and i < best_idx:
                    best_idx = i
                    best_num = num
                    best_den = den
        if best_idx == -1:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected: cannot allocate more")
        current[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    allocations = {names[i]: current[i] for i in range(n)}
    total_allocated = sum(current)
    return {
        "allocations": allocations,
        "names": names,
        "total_allocated": total_allocated
    }"}
